# getHarsh

> Harsh Joshi builds products and teams, from building controls to small-business software and GPU clouds. He has worked with AI since 2012.



## Start here

- [Harsh Joshi](https://getharsh.in/index.md) ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/))

- [The projects I pursue](https://getharsh.in/projects/index.md): Different homes for my applied, formal, economic and creative work. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/projects/))

- [Thoughts](https://getharsh.in/collections/index.md): Questions that develop across product work, learning and creative practice. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/collections/))

- [Blog](https://getharsh.in/blog/index.md): Essays that stand on their own, from leadership and product work to comedy, forgiveness and the scale of a breath. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/blog/))

- [About Harsh Joshi](https://getharsh.in/about/index.md): From building controls and small-business software to GPU cloud, and the people and questions that shaped the work. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/about/))


## Collections

- [Building products and teams](https://getharsh.in/collections/building-products-and-teams/index.md): Product judgment, technical research, shared responsibility and the systems that let useful work continue. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/collections/building-products-and-teams/))

- [Energy efficiency](https://getharsh.in/collections/energy-efficiency/index.md): What building energy products at Smart Joules taught me: savings that keep the service, controls that reach the plant and advice an operator can use. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/collections/energy-efficiency/))

- [Learning and practice](https://getharsh.in/collections/learning-and-practice/index.md): How curiosity, study, mentoring and feedback change what a person can do. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/collections/learning-and-practice/))

- [Meaning, models and creative practice](https://getharsh.in/collections/meaning-models-and-creative-practice/index.md): Personal inquiries into intelligence, time, memory and the forms through which a question becomes thinkable. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/collections/meaning-models-and-creative-practice/))


## Reading journeys

- [A career through problems](https://getharsh.in/collections/building-products-and-teams/a-career-through-problems/index.md): The movement through field engineering, customer-led products, AI applications and research-informed system building. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/collections/building-products-and-teams/a-career-through-problems/))

- [When research changes the product](https://getharsh.in/collections/building-products-and-teams/research-that-changes-the-product/index.md): From a technical promise to a useful measure and the developer's complete operation. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/collections/building-products-and-teams/research-that-changes-the-product/))

- [From service to control](https://getharsh.in/collections/energy-efficiency/from-service-to-control/index.md): An energy service gives a control its purpose, and observed consequences give advice something useful to learn from. ([HTML](https://getharsh.in/collections/energy-efficiency/from-service-to-control/))
